items.a: It is an AI advisor and dashboard for food businesses. It reads your sales, recipes and supplier prices, tells you what to change, and handles inventory, ordering and marketing guidance in one place.
Restaurants, food trucks, to-go and fast-food shops, and retail food stores.
You enter what goes into each product once. After that, every sale subtracts the ingredients it used, so stock and costs update on their own.
Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest, access is limited by role, and every sign-in and change is logged. It is never sold or shared, and you can export or delete it anytime.

items.q: Can I trust the AI's advice?
items.a: Recommendations come from your own sales, recipes and supplier data, and they show the numbers behind them so you can check the reasoning. Treat them as decision support, not a guarantee.
Core is {price}, our early-development price. You can cancel anytime.
